mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 2% MoM.
